findings.summary: MSYSTEM/TERM_PROGRAM env check treats mintty/MSYS2 as terminal regardless of stdout, so piped or redirected bat --help (including alias cat=bat) gets ANSI colors
Description and changelog claim a fix for regular file display the code does not make; root cause unverified and no test covers the change
Use is_some_and like env_no_color instead of map/unwrap_or
Two cfg'd copies of is_mintty_terminal for a one-line check; inline cfg!(windows) instead

why: Finding 1 states that the env-var check makes mintty always count as interactive, so piping and aliased cat get colors and decorations, matching the maintainer's question.
